---
title: "AprilTag tracking on Quest 3 in eight diagrams"
subtitle: "Technical paper series"
---

**English** · [Deutsch](uebersicht.html){hreflang=de lang=de}

The series follows a measurement from the corners of a tag in a camera image to its motion in WebXR space. Each paper addresses a physical question, derives the equations used by the implementation and shows how to check the result. The calibration paper is available as a draft. The remaining seven entries are proposed topics. Each diagram will be checked against the implementation before its paper is written.

| Diagram | Question |
|---|---|
| **01 · [Calibration](01-calibration.html)** | How can head motion around a stationary target reveal both the rigid camera-to-head transform and the time offset between the camera and WebXR? |
| **02 · World origin** | When do optical estimates of the target’s position and orientation agree closely enough to establish an XR anchor? |
| **03 · Single-tag tracking** | How do four image corners and a known edge length determine a metric pose? How can the tracker detect an implausible jump? |
| **04 · Multi-tag tracking** | How should the detector allocate search windows and processing time across tags that differ in speed and visibility? |
| **05 · Hand coupling** | How can a measured hand-to-object offset carry the object pose forward, and when does the rigid-coupling assumption break down? |
| **06 · Prediction** | How far can position and orientation be extrapolated from recent optical poses while waiting for the next observation? |
| **07 · Trajectory correction** | How does a new optical pose correct the end of a predicted trajectory segment, and how is the correction distributed over earlier points? |
| **08 · Perimeter** | How do markers on a tabletop define the vertices of a spatial boundary, and how does uncertainty in one vertex affect its outline? |

The [diagram collection](https://github.com/PiMaV/Quest3-WebXR-AprilTag/blob/main/docs/diagrams.md) shows how the modules fit together. [How Quest 3 finds a moving AprilTag again](index.html) connects several of them using a pendulum as an example.
